privacy_body:
1. Information We Collect
We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email, shipping address, and order history, as well as information generated through your use of the platform.

2. How We Use Your Information
We use your information to process orders, communicate with you about your account, and improve our services. Seller account information is used to facilitate the seller approval process.

3. Sharing of Information
We share order-relevant information (such as your name and shipping address) with the seller fulfilling your order. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

4. Payment Information
Payments are processed by our third-party payment provider. We do not store your full payment card details on our servers.

5. Cookies
We use cookies to keep you signed in and to remember your preferences.

6. Data Retention
We retain your account and order information for as long as your account remains active, or as needed to comply with legal obligations.

7. Your Choices
You may update or delete your account information from your account settings at any time.

8. Changes to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Continued use of ShopAI after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Policy.
